author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nate Eaton optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Boston Red Sox optioned Nate Eaton to Triple-A Worcester on Tuesday.
impact: Eaton received five plate appearances during his stint with the Red Sox after being called up July 8, going 0-for-4 with a walk and three strikeouts. He has a .125 AVG with a .563 OPS across 32 at-bats this season and will head back to Triple-A after a limited opportunity in the majors.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jahmai Jones traded to Red Sox
desc: The Boston Red Sox acquired Jahmai Jones from the Detroit Tigers for a player to be named later.
impact: Jones appeared in 57 games for Detroit this season, slashing .137/.219/.221 with two home runs. The 28-year-old is expected to serve as organizational outfield depth for Boston.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Raquet optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Baltimore Orioles have optioned Nick Raquet to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Raquet was called up from the minors on July 7 and made just one relief appearance, tossing a scoreless inning without allowing a hit. He has not allowed a run in his last three relief outings and will likely get another opportunity the next time Baltimore needs a reliever.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Junior Caminero (hand) has X-rays return negative
desc: Junior Caminero had X-rays return negative after he was hit by a pitch on his left hand during the All-Star game on Tuesday.
impact: Caminero was hit on the left hand by a 97-mph fast ball from Cardinals closer Riley O'Brien in the third inning. He appears to have avoided serious injury based on the initial imaging. He'll continue to be further evaluated the next day or two.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Misiorowski, Brewers have not began extension talks
desc: Jacob Misiorowski and the Brewers have reportedly not began any extension talks.
impact: Misiorowski has quickly emerged as one of the top pitchers in all of baseball. He leads the MLB heading into the All-Star break in ERA (1.62) and strikeouts (167).

author: Chris Schommer
title: Daulton Varsho swipes base in loss to Padres
desc: Daulton Varsho went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Padres with one run scored and one stolen base.
impact: Varsho has underwhelmed at the plate of late, picking up hits in three of his last 10 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more inconsistent bats in the Blue Jays lineup for manager John Schneider, batting .240 with seven home runs, nine steals, 24 RBI, and 36 runs scored across 83 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ernie Clement goes yard in loss to Padres
desc: Ernie Clement went 1-for-5 in a loss to the Padres with a two-run home run.
impact: Clement has caught fire at the plate of late, collecting hits in each of his last seven contests. The second baseman has rewarded manager John Schneider with one of the few impactful bats in an inconsistent Blue Jays lineup, slashing .296 with eight home runs, 32 RBI, 42 runs scored, and three stolen bases through 93 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin Gausman labors through six in loss to Padres
desc: Kevin Gausman allowed three earned runs on four hits and three walks while striking out eight over six innings in Sunday's loss to the Padres.
impact: Gausman has underwhelmed on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in six of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander has disappointed at the top of the Blue Jays rotation for much of the season, posting a 4.33 ERA and 1.22 WHIP with a 4-8 record and 9.3 K/9 ratio across 20 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Eugenio Suarez goes deep in loss to Cubs
desc: Eugenio Suarez went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Cubs with a two-run home run.
impact: Suarez continues a solid stretch at the plate, picking up hits in seven of his last 11 contests. The 34-year-old remains one of the more frustrating bats as part of an inconsistent Reds lineup, batting .208 with 11 home runs, 35 RBI, and 23 runs scored across 67 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Andrew Abbott fights command in no-decision
desc: Andrew Abbott allowed four earned runs on four hits and three walks while striking out three over four innings in Sunday's loss to the Cubs.
impact: Abbott has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in five of his last eight contests. The left-hander continues to battle inconsistent command for manager Terry Francona, posting a 4.11 ERA and 1.42 WHIP with a 5-5 record and 1.8 K/BB ratio through 20 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tarik Skubal solid on mound in loss to Phillies
desc: Tarik Skubal allowed two earned runs on four hits and one walk while striking out five over five innings in Sunday's loss to the Phillies.
impact: Skubal continues a steady stretch on the mound since returning from injury, allowing two earned runs or less in four of his last six trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of the more impactful arms in the Tigers rotation for manager AJ Hinch, carrying a 3.09 ERA and 0.95 WHIP with a 5-5 record and 10.6 K/9 ratio across 13 starts.

author: Chase Davis
title: Jordan Walker scores twice but can't save 4-3 loss to Braves
desc: Jordan Walker went 1-for-3 in a loss to Atlanta with two runs scored, a walk and a stolen base.
impact: After Sunday's loss to the Braves, Walker is batting .294 with 22 home runs, 74 RBI, 62 runs scored and 13 stolen bases across 93 games. He's got a four-RBI lead on Yordan Alvarez for first in the league.

author: Chase Davis
title: JoJo Romero takes loss vs. Braves
desc: JoJo Romero worked around a hit and a walk without allowing an earned run in Sunday's 4-3 loss to Atlanta.
impact: After Sunday's loss, Romero now has a 3.35 ERA and 1.30 WHIP with no saves, 2 blown saves and 20 holds through 44 appearances. He's got the most appearances out of the Cardinals' bullpen and is one of just a couple of southpaws. For that reason, he may never get a crack at the closer's role, but he is a great option in saves plus holds leagues.

author: Chase Davis
title: Dustin May's shaky command puts Cardinals in early hole
desc: Dustin May allowed two earned runs on two hits and four walks while striking out four over four innings in Sunday's 4-3 loss to Atlanta.
impact: May allowed only three hard hits and picked up seven whiffs on 84 pitches. Since the first complete game of his career on June 15, he's not completed more than 4.2 innings in any start. After the loss on Sunday, he owns a 4.55 ERA and 1.26 WHIP with a 5-6 record across 18 starts.

author: Chase Davis
title: Shohei Ohtani homers, doubles, but Dodgers fall short vs. Arizona
desc: Shohei Ohtani went 2-for-4 in loss to the Diamondbacks with a home run, a double, two runs scored, and one RBI.
impact: Through 88 games, Ohtani is slashing .293 with 22 home runs, 58 RBI, 65 runs scored, and six stolen bases, along with a .402 wOBA. He homered for the fourth time in his last six games. His knee doesn't appear to be an issue when at the plate.
